items.title: Meaning lenses: Starting check
items.prompt: Two students repeatedly use a hand signal, interpret it as a request to pause, and adjust their conversation. Which lens most directly explains how the signal gained meaning?
options: Symbolic interactionism: negotiated meanings in encounters
Social constructionism: stabilized categories in society
Exchange theory: reciprocal rewards and relationship costs
Rational choice theory: expected payoffs among options
items.directions: Select the best-supported option from the four choices.

items.title: Meaning lenses: Repair the near-use function
items.prompt: After missing an encounter-level item, which cue should be checked first to repair the lens-selection function?

Whether each actor calculates a separate expected payoff
Whether people interpret a symbol while coordinating action
Whether partners exchange rewards over a continuing relation
